evals.prompt: Build an Ondo UI profile form with name, email, biography, and notification preferences, including accessible validation states for invalid fields.
evals.expected_output: A form composed from Ondo Field primitives and controls with semantic validation and project-aware imports.
expectations: Uses FieldGroup and Field for the form layout
Uses FieldSet and FieldLegend for related notification preferences
Uses data-invalid on Field and aria-invalid on the invalid control
Uses InputGroupInput or InputGroupTextarea whenever an InputGroup is present
Uses semantic tokens and gap utilities instead of raw state colors or space utilities

evals.prompt: Create an Ondo UI dialog for editing a team member with an avatar, name and role fields, Save and Cancel actions, and the project's configured icon library.
evals.expected_output: An accessible Base UI Dialog using render composition, complete field structure, Avatar fallback, and configured icons.
expectations: Uses DialogTrigger with the Base UI render prop
Includes DialogTitle and DialogDescription in DialogContent
Includes AvatarFallback alongside AvatarImage
Reads and uses config.iconLibrary instead of assuming an icon package
Uses data-icon on inline button icons without component-owned sizing overrides

evals.prompt: Build an Ondo UI metrics dashboard with four cards, animated values, count badges, loading skeletons, and positive, warning, and destructive status treatments.
evals.expected_output: A dashboard using complete Card composition, NumberCount or NumberBadge, Skeleton, Badge, and Ondo semantic status tokens.
expectations: Uses CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, and CardFooter or CardAction appropriately
Uses NumberCount for animated metrics and NumberBadge when a count annotates another element
Uses Skeleton instead of custom animate-pulse placeholders
Uses Badge and semantic info, success, warning, or destructive tokens instead of raw palette colors
Uses gap and size utilities for layout

evals.prompt: Create an Ondo UI empty state for a project list with an icon, explanatory copy, primary create action, and secondary documentation link.
evals.expected_output: A standard EmptyView Composition, with lower-level Empty guidance only when the requested layout exceeds the Composition API.
expectations: Chooses EmptyView before rebuilding the standard pattern from Empty primitives
Uses a Button rendered as a link with nativeButton false for the documentation action
Uses the configured icon library
Explains that lower-level Empty primitives are the escape hatch for unsupported layouts
Uses semantic tokens and accessible action labels

evals.prompt: Build an Ondo UI streaming support chat with user and assistant messages, file attachments, a Today divider, automatic follow behavior, and a jump-to-latest control.
evals.expected_output: A chat composed from MessageScroller, Message, Bubble, Attachment, and Marker without hand-written scrolling behavior.
expectations: Uses the fixed MessageScrollerProvider, MessageScroller, MessageScrollerViewport, MessageScrollerContent, and MessageScrollerItem nesting
Uses Message and Bubble parts for message rows and surfaces
Uses Attachment parts for files and Marker for the Today divider
Uses MessageScrollerButton and autoScroll for jump-to-latest and streaming follow behavior
Does not implement ResizeObserver, scrollTop math, or a custom stick-to-bottom hook
